items.title: Digital Metabolism: Decoupling Logic from Facts via Regenerative Unlearning -- Towards a Pure Neural Logic Core
items.title_zh: 数字代谢：通过再生式遗忘将逻辑与事实解耦——迈向纯神经逻辑核心
items.summary: The authors propose "digital metabolism," a thermodynamic hypothesis that targeted forgetting is needed to distill a pure neural logic core by decoupling reasoning from factual knowledge in shared weights. Applying their Regenerative Logic-Core Protocol to Qwen2.5-0.5B produced near-zero retention of targeted facts (accuracy below 7%) and behavior the authors interpret as spontaneous chain-of-thought scaffolding on GSM8K, though they say the causal mechanism needs further study.

items.title: Reasoning Models Generate Societies of Thought
items.title_zh: 推理模型生成“思维社会”
items.summary: Analyzing reasoning traces from models such as DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B, the authors find that enhanced reasoning is associated with simulating multi-agent-like internal debate among perspectives with distinct personality traits and expertise, not extended computation alone. Controlled reinforcement-learning experiments show that base models increase conversational behaviors when rewarded only for reasoning accuracy, and conversational scaffolding accelerates later reasoning gains.

items.title: Grounding Agent Memory in Contextual Intent
items.title_zh: 将智能体记忆锚定于情境意图
items.summary: STITCH indexes each step of a long-horizon agent trajectory with a structured "contextual intent" cue—latent goal, action type, and salient entity types—and retrieves history by matching the current step's intent. Across the new CAME-Bench and LongMemEval it reports state-of-the-art results, beating the strongest baseline by 35.6%, with gains growing as trajectories lengthen.

items.title: PACEvolve: Enabling Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
items.title_zh: PACEvolve：实现进度感知的一致性演化
items.summary: PACEvolve targets self-evolving LLM agents that become anchored to local hypotheses and suffer context pollution and mode collapse, governing memory and search with hierarchical context management, momentum-based backtracking, and an adaptive collaborative evolution policy. The framework decouples high-level idea generation from low-level code evaluation and reports state-of-the-art results on complex evolutionary benchmarks.

items.title: ARC Prize 2025: Technical Report
items.organization: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Google DeepMind, xAI
items.summary: The 2025 ARC Prize report says 1,455 teams submitted 15,154 entries to ARC-AGI-2, with the top score reaching 24% on the private evaluation set. It identifies per-task refinement loops as the year's defining theme and argues that frontier reasoning remains constrained by knowledge coverage, encouraging new forms of benchmark contamination.

items.title: A Concise Agent is Less Expert: Revealing Side Effects of Using Style Features on Conversational Agents
items.title_zh: 简洁的智能体显得更不专业：揭示对话智能体风格特征使用的副作用
items.summary: A systematic study of 127 conversational-agent papers identifies 12 frequently used style features and uses controlled synthetic dialogues with pairwise LLM-as-judge evaluation to show that prompting for one style causally affects others—for example, prompting for conciseness significantly reduces perceived expertise. Prompt-based and activation-steering mitigations can partially restore suppressed traits but often degrade the primary intended style.

items.title: LLMs for Game Theory: Entropy-Guided In-Context Learning and Adaptive CoT Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向博弈论的 LLM：熵引导的上下文学习与自适应思维链推理
items.summary: The paper combines in-context learning with entropy-guided chain-of-thought reasoning and adaptive context retrieval, adjusting the number of retrieved examples and reasoning paths to token-level uncertainty in discrete game-theoretic tasks. In 100 Tic-Tac-Toe games against a sub-optimal algorithmic opponent, average game outcome improved from -11.6% for the baseline LLM to +9.5% with the entropy-guided method.

items.title: alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim
items.title_zh: alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim：精简的 OpenCode 多代理套件
items.summary: oh-my-opencode-slim is described as a lean, fine-tuned multi-agent suite for OpenCode that can mix any models and automatically delegate tasks; GitHub lists TypeScript as the repository language.

items.title: michaelshimeles/ralphy
items.title_zh: michaelshimeles/ralphy：循环调用编码代理直到 PRD 完成
items.summary: Ralphy is an autonomous Bash script that loops Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor's agent, Qwen, and Droid until a product requirements document is finished; GitHub lists TypeScript for the repository.

items.title: A Practical Guide to Building AI Agents
items.title_zh: 构建 AI 智能体的实用指南
items.summary: OpenAI published a guide to designing, orchestrating, and deploying AI agents that covers use cases, model selection, tool design, guardrails, and multi-agent patterns.

items.title: Building with the GPT-5 Model Series: A Practical Guide
items.title_zh: 使用 GPT-5 模型系列构建应用：实用指南
items.summary: OpenAI published a practical guide for startups on migrating to the Responses API, designing agents, tuning prompts, steering GPT-5 models, and building reliable AI workflows.

items.title: Jan 15, 2026 Product Engineering Files Are All You Need Read
items.title_zh: 2026 年 1 月 15 日产品工程：文件就是你所需要的一切
items.summary: LlamaIndex published a product-engineering blog post titled "Files Are All You Need"; the fetched content contains only the headline, so no further details are available.
